## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `adopt` record makes the command print each adopted setting twice, which should be fixed: `plan` emits the line directly and `run` then emits it again from the returned record.

## Changes
`plan` now appends an `adopt` record for each setting that already exists and a trailing `audit` record carrying the count of incoming settings. The pull request also adds two tests for the audit record through `run`, and a one-line text file, `app/review.txt`.

(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop emitting adopted settings twice from `run` — `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits `Adopted theme` twice: the new `adopt` record reaches the loop at `app/cli.py:9`, which emits every non-audit message, after `plan` already emitted the same line at `app/planner.py:8`. — The command prints a duplicate progress line for every setting that already exists, and no test calls `run` with an existing setting. — Fix: Skip `adopt` records alongside `audit` at `app/cli.py:7`, and add a `run` case with an existing setting to `tests/test_planner.py`.
